title: Anarchy `n` explosives prelude volume
summary: This is a photocopied-style underground text file from the late 1980s bulletin-board and zine scene, written in an informal, boastful voice and distributed among hobbyists. The Prelude Volume opens with a jokey introduction to a liquid nitrogen bottle device and a list of toll-free phone numbers and 'amusement' hotlines, then moves into a mixed collection of chemistry experiments, including oxygen generation from hydrogen peroxide and dust-fireball demonstrations. It also gives step-by-step procedures for making nitroglycerin and TNT, which are dangerous and illegal to attempt. Surrounding these are phone-phreaking material such as blue box tone tables, black box and hold-circuit schematics, and a long glossary of telecommunications terms. The later pages include a reprinted US government hazardous-materials hotline directory and a brown-box party-line description. The file is an archive of instructions for explosives and telephone fraud, presented as a collection of loosely connected documents rather than a coherent work. The text is damaged in places, with garbled characters and missing lines. It is reproduced here for cataloguing purposes only, and its contents describe dangerous and unlawful activities.
